name: Multi-Motor Integration
description: Ability to design and build systems using multiple motors working together for increased power and control.

name: Compound Gearing
description: Understanding and implementing compound gear systems to achieve specific speed and torque ratios.

name: Four-Bar Linkage Design
description: Designing and building four-bar linkage mechanisms for lifts and manipulators with parallel motion.

name: Sensor Integration
description: Using distance, color, and bumper sensors in programs to create responsive autonomous behaviors.

name: Autonomous Routine Planning
description: Creating multi-step autonomous programs that accomplish complex tasks with sensor feedback.

name: PID Control Basics
description: Understanding proportional control to improve motor positioning and movement accuracy.

name: Advanced Drivetrain Control
description: Mastering precise control of multi-motor drivetrains including turning radius and acceleration control.

name: Field-Oriented Strategy
description: Developing efficient movement patterns and strategies for specific competition field layouts.

name: Mechanism Operation Timing
description: Coordinating multiple mechanism operations while driving for maximum efficiency.

name: Team Role Specialization
description: Identifying team member strengths and assigning specialized roles (builder, programmer, driver, scout).

name: Match Strategy Development
description: Creating team strategies for competitions including alliance coordination and scoring priorities.

name: Engineering Notebook Organization
description: Maintaining detailed, organized engineering notebook entries documenting design process and decisions.

name: Iterative Design Process
description: Following systematic design-build-test-improve cycles to optimize robot performance.

name: Constraint Analysis
description: Identifying and working within game rules, size limits, and mechanical constraints during design.

name: Performance Measurement
description: Collecting and analyzing data on robot performance to guide design improvements.
